# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V8005 dependencies_not_supported"
description: "A [dependencies] entry in sakura.toml uses a form this release does not support (RFC 0003 §1.4)."
---

An error from the `package` phase. `sakura explain V8005` prints this explanation offline.

A `[dependencies]` entry in `sakura.toml` uses a form this release does not support (RFC 0003
§1.4). Packages are experimental: `path` dependencies are supported; a version floor parses, and
locking it from a registry arrives with `sakura sync` in a later release; `git` dependencies are not
supported yet. The message names the form; the diagnostic points at the entry. Earlier
releases refused every `[dependencies]` table with this code; a table that is empty, or whose
entries are all supported, now compiles. Nothing is fetched.

Wrong:

```toml
[dependencies]
scraper = { git = "https://github.com/acme/scraper", rev = "9f2c0b7e1a4d3c6b8e5f7a9d0c1b2e3f4a5b6c7d" }
```

Fixed (a local checkout of the same commit):

```toml
[dependencies]
scraper = { path = "../scraper" }
```

[`compiler/tests/ui/V8005_git_dependency/`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V8005_git_dependency/), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
// RFC 0003 §1.4: a `git` dependency is a form this release does not support yet, at the entry;
// plan P5 adds git sources and turns this fixture into a positive one. Nothing is fetched.
pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hi") }
```

`sakura.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"

[dependencies]
scraper = { git = "https://github.com/acme/scraper", rev = "9f2c0b7e1a4d3c6b8e5f7a9d0c1b2e3f4a5b6c7d" }
```
